definition: מַחֲנָק noun [masculine] strangling, suffocation , as a mode of death, וַתִּבְחַר מַחֲנָק נַפְשִׁי Job 7:15 and my soul chooseth strangling (|| מָוֶת ). חַנָּתֹן see sub. חִנן
